evidence.detail: Fix a lot of what is broken about the Discord bot (2024-05-12) — moved all commands to slash commands using Extension subclasses; whois.py and tournament.py both updated to remove broken prefixed_command usage
Whois class extends Extension with @slash_command decorators; no prefixed_commands dependency
Tournament class extends Extension with @slash_command(); setup(bot) function present

triage.notes: Issue filed 2024-05-11; fix landed the next day. The root cause was that the prefixed_commands extension API had changed in the interactions upgrade; the fix moved all commands to pure slash commands.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in commit 63417c08 (2024-05-12): both /whois and /tournament were migrated to proper slash commands using interactions-py's Extension pattern, resolving the breakage from the interactions lib upgrade.
